failure_modes.cause: Low flow rate (0.1 mL/min) and long residence time (105.5 min) increase risk of product or byproduct precipitation in laminar flow (Re=6), especially if solubility limits are approached at 50°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Implement in-line UV/Vis monitoring for turbidity; add back-flush capability; ensure solvent composition maintains >1.5x solubility margin

failure_modes.cause: Very low flow rate (0.1 mL/min) with acetonitrile at 50°C (high vapour pressure) can cause cavitation in syringe or gear pumps, leading to inconsistent residence time and conversion
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurize feed reservoir to 1.0 bar above solvent vapour pressure; use positive displacement pump with low-pulsation design; install in-line pressure sensor before reactor

failure_modes.mode: Incomplete mixing leading to selectivity loss
failure_modes.cause: Laminar flow (Re=6) in 0.75 mm coil relies on diffusion; if mixing is not enhanced (e.g., via static mixers or segmented flow), concentration gradients may persist, reducing selectivity advantage
failure_modes.mitigation: Validate mixing efficiency using tracer study (e.g., Rhodamine B); incorporate static mixing elements if residence time distribution exceeds 10% variance

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — failure to maintain 3.0 bar causes boiling and flow stoppage
Single pump — failure halts entire process with no redundancy
validation_experiments: Run blank acetonitrile at Q=0.1 mL/min and 50°C for 120 min; monitor pressure stability and check for pump cavitation via acoustic emission or pressure oscillation analysis
Perform tracer study (e.g., UV-active dye) to measure residence time distribution (RTD); confirm variance <10% to validate mixing adequacy
Conduct 24-hour continuous run with in-line UV/Vis monitoring for turbidity; collect outlet samples every 30 min to detect early signs of precipitation or conversion drift
